messages:
infra-bot: PAGER — SEV2: billing/metering delayed snapshot writes detected; token counts lagging, some customers seeing overage flags. Auto-created incident #INC-2850. Notify oncall.
Emma (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Any customer-facing alerts? :eyes:
Raj (sre): jumping in. Initial look: ingestion consumers are healthy, but the snapshot flusher for windowed aggregation hasn't emitted for ~22m. Counts in `metering-agg` are stale.
Nina (billing): customers reported overage emails starting 15m ago. We have at least 12 customers with temporary flags; list coming.
Emma (oncall): Nina — can you paste a short list and severity? We'll triage order.
Nina (billing): quick list: acme-inc (high), beta-ml (medium), coreapps (low). Email UI shows spikes that don't match token logs — looks like emit delay not counts.
Raj (sre): I ran a quick query against raw emitter stream:
```sql
SELECT source, count(*) AS queued, max(event_ts) as last_seen
FROM metering.raw_events
WHERE event_ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY queued DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Results: emitter-shard-4 has 0 recent writes since 22:03:12; others normal.
Emma (oncall): suspicious. Any recent deploys to metering-aggregator or sharding changes?
Raj (sre): No deploys in the last 2 hours. I see flusher GC spikes on shard 4 host (m-agg-4): memory pressure + full GC around 22:02:xx, then process stuck. Pulling logs.
Lucy (support): I'm drafting a narrow customer note template in case we need to suppress or retract overage emails. Will post once we know mitigation.
Raj (sre): tail of m-agg-4 logs:
```
2026-03-15T22:02:18Z ERROR Flusher failed to emit snapshot: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
2026-03-15T22:02:19Z WARN Retrying flush in 5s (attempt 1)
2026-03-15T22:03:10Z ERROR Retry limit reached, halting flush thread
```
Emma (oncall): OOM on a flusher thread explains the emit gap. Plan: restart m-agg-4, temporarily route new emitter traffic away from shard 4, kick off backfill job to re-emit snapshots for the 22:00-22:25 window, and disable automated overage emails for impacted customers until counts reconciled. Consent?
Paul (product): +1 on suppression for impacted customers. We shouldn't spam them with false overage alerts. Need comms window and ETA.
Nina (billing): please suppress emails for the three flagged accounts now. I'll prepare an outbound note once we have ETA.
Raj (sre): actioning routing and restart now. Commands:
```bash
# mark shard unhealthy in router
curl -XPOST https://infra-router.internal/shards/m-agg-4/mark_unhealthy -d '{"reason":"OOM flusher"}'
# restart service
kubectl rollout restart deployment/meters-agg --namespace=prod -l shard=m-agg-4
```
Emma (oncall): ping once restart finishes and when router confirms traffic drained.
Raj (sre): restart finished, logs show flusher restarted and GC stable. Router shows shard 4 draining complete.
Raj (sre): kicking off backfill job: `backfill-snapshots --start=2026-03-15T22:00:00Z --end=2026-03-15T22:25:00Z --shards=4` — estimated runtime ~6m.
Lucy (support): email suppression toggled for acme-inc and beta-ml and coreapps. I left a support note on their tickets.
Nina (billing): thanks — I'll hold outbound comms pending final recon.
Emma (oncall): monitor token delta between raw_events and billing aggregates. Raj — can you paste the reconcile query outputs when backfill completes?
Raj (sre): backfill completed. Reconcile snapshot:
```sql
SELECT c.customer, raw.tokens AS raw_tokens, agg.tokens AS agg_tokens, agg.tokens - raw.tokens AS delta
FROM (
  SELECT customer, sum(tokens) AS tokens FROM metering.raw_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T22:25:00Z' GROUP BY customer
) raw
JOIN (
  SELECT customer, sum(tokens) AS tokens FROM metering.aggregates WHERE window_start = '2026-03-15T22:00:00Z' GROUP BY customer
) agg USING (customer)
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Output shows deltas reconciled to <= 0-3 tokens for affected customers. acme-inc: delta 0, beta-ml: 2, coreapps: 1.
Nina (billing): perfect. Those overage flags look spurious now. I'll retract the emails and send an apology note with explanation and ETA on improved monitoring.
Lucy (support): retraction sent to affected customers, included that we're investigating and will follow up. No escalations on support threads yet.
Paul (product): can we add an automatic check so if snapshot emitter hasn't emitted within 2m, we silence overage emails until backfill confirmed? That would've prevented this.
Emma (oncall): good follow-up. Short-term mitigation: add a hold-window config for overage-emailer when window emit lag > 2m. Long-term: autoscale flusher memory and alert on GC stalls.
Raj (sre): filing a follow-up JIRA: MTR-1283 (flusher autoscale + emit-lag hold); adding playbook steps to silence overage emails during emit lag.
Emma (oncall): incident wrap: root cause: OOM in flusher thread on m-agg-4 causing snapshot emit gap -> transient overage flags. Mitigation: restart, drain shard, backfill, suppress emails, customer comms. Owners: Raj (sre) for infra fixes, Nina (billing) for comms, Paul (product) for product change. Postmortem in #postmortems.
infra-bot: INCIDENT #INC-2850 status -> RESOLVED by Emma (oncall) at 2026-03-15T23:04:00Z.
Emma (oncall): thanks everyone. Please add any notes to the incident ticket. I'll schedule postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
